examples.trans: I am fine, let me go quickly.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'go, walk', paired with 'пойти'.

examples.text: Я иду домой.
examples.trans: I'm going home.

examples.text: Он идёт на второй срок.
examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to work', paired with 'поработать'.

examples.text: Ладно, давай быстро иди работать.
examples.trans: Alright, go on and get to work quickly.

examples.text: Да всё нормально, наш завод работает, всё идёт хорошо.
examples.trans: Everything is fine, our factory is working, everything is going well.

examples.text: Я работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I work as mayor.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'no', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Нет, это совсем не факт.
examples.trans: No, that is not a fact at all.

examples.text: Я хочу — плачу, а хочу — нет.
examples.trans: If I want to I pay, and if I want to I do not.

examples.text: Ну, чаще всего нет, конечно.
examples.trans: Well, most often not, of course.

meanings.en: nowhere, not anywhere (direction/destination, used with не or нет)
meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'nowhere', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Вика с вами никуда не пойдёт.
examples.trans: Vika will not go anywhere with you.

examples.text: Вика никуда не пойдёт!
examples.trans: Vika will not go anywhere!

examples.text: Нет, никуда я отсюда не пойду!
examples.trans: No, I am not going anywhere from here!

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'сюда').

examples.text: Нет, никуда я отсюда не пойду!
examples.trans: No, I am not going anywhere from here!

examples.text: Давай быстро уезжаем отсюда!
examples.trans: Let us drive away from here quickly!

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда.
examples.trans: I'll get out of here.

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will go', paired with 'идти'.

examples.text: Вика с вами никуда не пойдёт.
examples.trans: Vika will not go anywhere with you.

examples.text: Вика никуда не пойдёт!
examples.trans: Vika will not go anywhere!

examples.text: Нет, никуда я отсюда не пойду!
examples.trans: No, I am not going anywhere from here!

остановиться.gloss: to stop, to come to a halt

meanings.en: to stop, to pause, to come to a halt
meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to stop, to come to a halt', paired with 'останавливаться'.

examples.text: Он только начал бояться, а ты остановился!
examples.trans: He just started getting scared, and you stopped!

examples.text: Остановилась там кровь уже?
examples.trans: Has the bleeding stopped yet?

examples.text: Ваня, ты что? Он только начал бояться, а ты остановился!
examples.trans: Vanya, what is wrong with you? He just started getting scared, and you stopped!
